verdict.rationale: Green and Spiegel is an immigration law firm offering legal services such as visa applications, consultations and compliance support. It is not a software platform that hosts user data, so self-serve export of all data in open formats is a category error for this kind of product. The 404 probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI confirm there is no software surface, but they are not grounds for a 'none' verdict on an inapplicable axis.
